model.dimensionality: 2D periodic slab model represented in a 3D periodic supercell

path.purpose: A fixed reciprocal-space teaching path that includes K; it is not full-Brillouin-zone sampling.

limitations: The minimum workflow is not a universal complete workflow.
Material-, model-, and observable-specific controls may add stages and convergence dimensions.
The stated 0.01 eV/atom tolerance is only a future cutoff-comparison contract; it does not turn this one run into a convergence result.
Vacuum, k mesh, smearing, path, and observable convergence remain untested.
objective: Teaching-only 2D graphene SCF followed by a fixed Gamma-K-M-Gamma band path; no full-zone property or material claim.

observable.name: SCF total energy per atom cutoff comparison
